parameters.name: AccessKey
parameters.description: The AccessKey ID that is used to connect to EventBridge.

parameters.name: AccessSecret
parameters.description: The AccessKey secret that is used to connect to EventBridge.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the EventBridge integration.

parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: EventBusRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the event bus.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The ID of the EventBridge integration.

*   If you do not specify this parameter, an EventBridge integration is created.
*   If you specify this parameter, the specified EventBridge integration is modified.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the EventBridge integration.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-or-update-event-bridge-integration --id 123 --name EventBridge_Test --description test --biz-endpoint http://xxxxx --access-key abc000000000000000000 --access-secret abc000000000000000000 --event-bus-name EventBus_Test --source arms --event-bus-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms CreateOrUpdateEventBridgeIntegration --region cn-hangzhou --EventBusName EventBus_Test --AccessSecret abc000000000000000000 --Description test --Endpoint 'http://xxxxx' --Id 123 --AccessKey abc000000000000000000 --EventBusRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Source arms --Name EventBridge_Test
